card.title: Keeper of the Stakes
card.instruction: Remain understated while controlling the reward, penalty, deadline, or condition that determines what winning actually means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations on winning the raffle. The prize is this hamper, once you've returned the basket.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need the basket to carry everything home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can borrow it until six. I'll keep the chocolates as a deposit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My bus doesn't get back until seven.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Seven is fine. I'll need the wine as well.

mechanism: A quietly conditions a raffle prize through basket timing and deposits taken from the reward.
confusable: Unlike overt rivalry, A must control what winning yields through practical conditions while staying understated.
comparison: S198-a trades return time for more of the hamper; protected S198-b concerns allocation dates and is not reopened.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
